park-cities-baptist-dallas.assessment: Park Cities Baptist Church is a large Dallas megachurch (10,000 members, est. 1939) led by Dr. Jeff Warren since 2010. The church withdrew from the SBC in October 2024 specifically over the convention's push to restrict female pastors — a significant red flag for complementarian evaluation. Pastor Warren has publicly advocated for women in ministry, stating Jesus 'did not genderize the Great Commission.' The church affirms the 1963 Baptist Faith & Message (notably NOT the stricter 2000 version) and states men and women 'serve equally alongside each other.' Women serve on the Board of Trustees and chair standing committees. While the church maintains orthodox Christology, gospel-centered language, and active mission engagement, the explicit egalitarian trajectory places it in the RED category for gender/biblical design. The church remains affiliated with Texas Baptists (BGCT) and Dallas Baptist Association but has reduced denominational accountability after leaving the SBC. Not recommended for men seeking a church with complementarian convictions, but doctrinally sound on core gospel issues.

passion-city-church-atlanta.assessment: Passion City Church and Louie Giglio's broader Passion movement have done genuine good in mobilizing young adults for worship and anti-trafficking causes. However, the church is personality-driven, conference-culture oriented, and topical in preaching style. Giglio has shown some cultural accommodation tendencies and the ministry lacks the doctrinal precision and male-headship emphasis that MOOP values. Not a bad church, but not a GREEN church either. YELLOW — good entry point for young believers but needs stronger expository and patriarchal commitments.

passion-city-church-dc.assessment: Passion City Church DC is the DC campus of Passion City Church (Atlanta), led by Ben Stuart as city pastor. Ben Stuart is a compelling teacher with solid biblical scholarship — his book 'Single, Dating, Engaged, Married' demonstrates theological depth and pastoral care. He earned his M.A. in historical theology at Dallas Theological Seminary. Passion City Church originated from the Passion movement (Louie Giglio) which is evangelical and mission-focused. Strengths: gifted communicator, strong young adult/college ministry, passion for global missions. Cautions: multi-site model disperses local eldership accountability; DC context creates constant pressure toward cultural accommodation; large church culture can undermine deep community. For a man in DC wanting strong preaching and young adult community, Passion City DC is worth attending — evaluate the elder structure and men's ministry depth before committing long-term.
